entities.title: Death
entities.summary: What dying does: the reset, four wreck canisters, 61 dying ticks and the return to the title.
entities.purpose: Carries out the player's death (RULES B.18, C.10.4, D.3.10) for whichever rule caused it, cancels a running countdown (deliberate difference 5), and returns to the title with the last saved pilot.
boundaries: A feature: it uses capabilities and other features, never a use case (tests/layers.rs).
It does not decide when the player dies; the callers pass a Cause.
